snippet.title: The Delicate Balance of Peace in Europe
snippet.description:
Peace in Europe is a delicate and complex issue. 
In this video, we explore the different viewpoints: the United States, Russia and European NATO allies.

With a long and rich history, Europe has struggled to maintain long-lasting peace. NATO was created not only to fight the Soviet Union but also to ensure a common security framework. The Cold War ended without a nuclear war. The Soviet Union collapsed and multiple countries have since joined the Atlantic Alliance. 
Peace in Europe has always depended on the delicate balance between NATO and Russia.
Today, however, the situation is once again uncertain with the Russia Ukraine war. We have to be reminded of the different levels of threat, viewpoints and strategic interests.
